name: Zhangyanming tablets (Chinese herbal formula)
short: Few data; one trial (144 dry-eye patients, tablets plus eye drops): safety data, including liver and kidney tests, did not differ significantly from placebo. No event counts given.
text: Few data; only one study was found. In a stratified, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial at 3 centres in 144 patients with dry eye (119 completed), the tablets or placebo tablets were taken with 0.1% sodium hyaluronate eye drops; safety was assessed by adverse events, vital signs, blood and urine tests, liver and kidney function and electrocardiograms, and safety data did not differ significantly between the groups. The abstract gives no adverse-event counts and does not list the tablets' herbs. No interaction data were found in the cited sources.
